svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.9.12 Concealed Spaces above Fire Separations
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.9.12 Concealed Spaces above Fire Separations
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Concealed Spaces above Fire Separations

g.text: Concealed space above it: divided by
Space not divided: the ceiling is a fire
separation rated not less than the
Vertical fire separation needing not more
than 45 min: ceiling may be 30 min

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
A horizontal service space or other concealed
space located above a required vertical fire
separation is divided at the fire separation
by an equivalent fire separation within the
space
Except as provided in Sentence (2).
Where the concealed space is above a required
vertical fire separation other than a vertical
shaft, it need not be divided, provided the
construction between the space and the space
below is a fire separation with a rating not
less than that required for the vertical fire
separation
Where the vertical fire separation is not
required to have a rating greater than 45 min,
the rating of the ceiling may be reduced to 30
min.
Drawn: slices through a storey, cut faces toward you. Red: fire separations. Heights are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.9.12. (page 9-70)
